passages.title: A disagreement about the cycle path

lines.speaker: Karim
lines.fr: Tu as vu ? Ils ont enfin commencé les travaux de la piste cyclable.
lines.en: Have you seen? They’ve finally started the work on the cycle path.

lines.speaker: Sylvie
lines.fr: Oui, et franchement, je trouve que c’est une mauvaise idée : on perd cinquante places de parking.
lines.en: Yes, and honestly, I think it’s a bad idea: we’re losing fifty parking spaces.

lines.speaker: Karim
lines.fr: Peut-être, mais si les gens prenaient leur vélo, il y aurait moins de voitures devant l’école.
lines.en: Maybe, but if people took their bikes, there would be fewer cars in front of the school.

lines.speaker: Sylvie
lines.fr: Je suis d’accord sur le principe. Pourtant, ma mère a quatre-vingts ans et elle ne peut pas venir à vélo.
lines.en: I agree in principle. Yet my mother is eighty and she can’t come by bike.

lines.speaker: Karim
lines.fr: C’est vrai. La mairie a promis des places réservées près du marché.
lines.en: That’s true. The town hall has promised reserved spaces near the market.

lines.speaker: Sylvie
lines.fr: Promis, oui. On verra si elles existent vraiment en septembre.
lines.en: Promised, yes. We’ll see whether they really exist in September.

questions.explanation: “Qu’ils viennent voir. En cinq minutes par semaine, on comprend tout.”

passages.title: Radio news: the road along the river

lines.fr: Il est huit heures. Voici les informations de la région.
lines.en: It is eight o’clock. Here is the news for the region.

lines.fr: Après les fortes pluies de la nuit, la route qui longe la rivière reste fermée entre Saint-Clair et Mérens.
lines.en: After the heavy rain during the night, the road that runs along the river remains closed between Saint-Clair and Mérens.

lines.fr: Deux écoles n’ouvriront pas ce matin ; les enfants sont accueillis à la salle des fêtes.
lines.en: Two schools will not open this morning; the children are being looked after in the village hall.

lines.fr: La mairie demande aux habitants d’éviter la voiture et promet un point complet à midi.
lines.en: The town hall is asking residents to avoid the car and promises a full update at midday.

questions.question: Why is the road closed?
choices: Because of the heavy rain during the night.
Because of work on the bridge.
Because of an accident this morning.
Because of the snow.
questions.explanation: “Après les fortes pluies de la nuit, la route ... reste fermée”.

questions.question: What is happening to the children this morning?
choices: They are being looked after in the village hall.
They are staying at home with their parents.
They are going to a school in Saint-Clair.
They are taken to Mérens by bus.
questions.explanation: “les enfants sont accueillis à la salle des fêtes”.

questions.question: What does the town hall ask residents to do?
choices: Avoid using the car.
Stay at home all day.
Telephone the school.
Help clear the road.
questions.explanation: “La mairie demande aux habitants d’éviter la voiture”.

questions.question: When will there be a full update?
choices: At midday.
At eight o’clock.
This evening.
Tomorrow morning.
questions.explanation: “promet un point complet à midi”.

lines.fr: À partir du mois d’octobre, la bibliothèque ouvrira le dimanche de dix heures à dix-sept heures.
lines.en: From October on, the library will open on Sundays from ten to five.

lines.fr: En revanche, elle restera fermée le lundi, faute de personnel.
lines.en: On the other hand, it will stay closed on Mondays, for lack of staff.

lines.fr: Une réunion publique aura lieu jeudi prochain à la salle du conseil pour discuter de ces horaires.
lines.en: A public meeting will take place next Thursday in the council chamber to discuss these hours.

lines.fr: Les habitants qui ne peuvent pas venir peuvent envoyer leur avis par courriel avant vendredi.
lines.en: Residents who cannot come may send their opinion by email before Friday.

questions.question: What changes from October?
choices: The library will open on Sundays.
The library will open on Mondays.
The library will close every afternoon.
The library will move to the council chamber.
questions.explanation: “la bibliothèque ouvrira le dimanche”.

questions.question: Why will the library stay closed on Mondays?
choices: There are not enough staff.
There is building work.
Too few people come on Mondays.
The public meeting is held there.
questions.explanation: “elle restera fermée le lundi, faute de personnel”.

questions.question: Where will the public meeting take place?
choices: In the council chamber.
In the library.
At the school.
In the market square.
questions.explanation: “jeudi prochain à la salle du conseil”.

questions.question: What can residents who cannot come do?
choices: Send their opinion by email before Friday.
Telephone the library on Sunday.
Write in the book at the entrance.
Ask a neighbour to speak for them.
questions.explanation: “peuvent envoyer leur avis par courriel avant vendredi”.

passages.title: Email to the neighbours about the trees

lines.fr: Bonjour à tous, je vous écris au sujet des travaux de la place du Marché.
lines.en: Hello everyone, I’m writing to you about the work on Market Square.

lines.fr: On nous avait promis que les six vieux platanes seraient gardés ; or trois ont été coupés mardi.
lines.en: We had been promised that the six old plane trees would be kept; yet three were cut down on Tuesday.

lines.fr: Je ne suis pas contre le projet, mais je voudrais qu’on nous explique cette décision.
lines.en: I am not against the project, but I would like someone to explain this decision to us.

lines.fr: Si vous êtes d’accord, nous pourrions demander un rendez-vous à la mairie avant la fin du mois.
lines.en: If you agree, we could ask the town hall for an appointment before the end of the month.

lines.fr: Répondez-moi vite : je dois envoyer la lettre vendredi.
lines.en: Answer me quickly: I have to send the letter on Friday.

questions.question: What had the residents been promised?
choices: That the six old plane trees would be kept.
That the square would be closed to cars.
That the work would end in May.
That three new trees would be planted.
questions.explanation: “On nous avait promis que les six vieux platanes seraient gardés”.

questions.question: What happened on Tuesday?
choices: Three of the trees were cut down.
The work was stopped.
The town hall answered the letter.
Six trees were planted.
questions.explanation: “or trois ont été coupés mardi”.

questions.question: What is the writer’s position on the project?
choices: Not against it, but wanting an explanation.
Completely against it.
Entirely happy with the town hall.
Ready to plant new trees instead.
questions.explanation: “Je ne suis pas contre le projet, mais je voudrais qu’on nous explique cette décision.”

questions.question: Why must the neighbours answer quickly?
choices: The letter has to be sent on Friday.
The meeting is on Tuesday.
The work ends this week.
The town hall closes for the month.
questions.explanation: “je dois envoyer la lettre vendredi”.

lines.fr: Selon le rapport publié lundi par la mairie, le recyclage a augmenté de quinze pour cent en un an.
lines.en: According to the report published on Monday by the town hall, recycling has risen by fifteen per cent in a year.

lines.fr: Ce sont surtout les habitants des immeubles qui trient davantage, alors qu’on attendait le contraire.
lines.en: It is above all the residents of blocks of flats who sort more, whereas the opposite was expected.

lines.fr: Le verre, lui, recule : les bouteilles finissent encore trop souvent dans la poubelle grise.
lines.en: Glass, however, is falling back: bottles still end up far too often in the grey bin.

lines.fr: La ville va donc installer vingt nouveaux bacs à verre près des écoles et des commerces.
lines.en: The town is therefore going to install twenty new glass bins near the schools and the shops.

questions.question: By how much has recycling risen?
choices: Fifteen per cent in a year.
Five per cent in a year.
Fifteen per cent in a month.
Fifty per cent in a year.
questions.explanation: “le recyclage a augmenté de quinze pour cent en un an”.

questions.question: Who sorts more than expected?
choices: The residents of blocks of flats.
Families with young children.
The shopkeepers of the town centre.
People who live in houses.
questions.explanation: “Ce sont surtout les habitants des immeubles qui trient davantage”.

questions.question: What is the problem with glass?
choices: Bottles still go into the grey bin too often.
There is no glass bin in the town.
Glass is no longer collected.
Bottles are too heavy to carry.
questions.explanation: “les bouteilles finissent encore trop souvent dans la poubelle grise”.

questions.question: What is the town going to do?
choices: Install twenty new glass bins.
Fine people who do not sort.
Publish a second report.
Empty the grey bins twice a week.
questions.explanation: “La ville va donc installer vingt nouveaux bacs à verre”.

passages.title: A month with the town hall app

lines.fr: J’ai testé pendant un mois l’application que la mairie a lancée au printemps.
lines.en: I tested for a month the app that the town hall launched in the spring.

lines.fr: L’idée est bonne : on y trouve les horaires des bus, les travaux et les décisions du conseil.
lines.en: The idea is good: you find the bus times, the roadworks and the council’s decisions on it.

lines.fr: Le problème, c’est qu’elle ne marche pas sans connexion et qu’elle vide la batterie en deux heures.
lines.en: The problem is that it doesn’t work without a connection and that it drains the battery in two hours.

lines.fr: Si la mairie voulait vraiment aider les habitants, elle enverrait aussi un message court chaque semaine.
lines.en: If the town hall really wanted to help residents, it would also send a short message every week.

lines.fr: Pour l’instant, je continue à lire le journal du quartier, qui est gratuit et que tout le monde comprend.
lines.en: For now, I go on reading the neighbourhood newspaper, which is free and which everyone understands.

questions.question: How long did the writer test the app?
choices: For a month.
For a week.
Since the spring.
For two hours.
questions.explanation: “J’ai testé pendant un mois”.

questions.question: What can you find in the app?
choices: Bus times, roadworks and council decisions.
Weather forecasts and adverts.
Local job offers.
Photographs of the neighbourhood.
questions.explanation: “on y trouve les horaires des bus, les travaux et les décisions du conseil”.

questions.question: What are the writer’s two complaints?
choices: It needs a connection and it drains the battery.
It is expensive and slow.
It only works on new phones.
It gives the wrong bus times.
questions.explanation: “elle ne marche pas sans connexion et ... elle vide la batterie en deux heures”.

questions.question: What does the writer still read?
choices: The free neighbourhood newspaper.
The regional daily paper.
The town hall’s emails.
The notices outside the town hall.
questions.explanation: “je continue à lire le journal du quartier, qui est gratuit”.
